Recently visited Happy Homes in Mulund and honestly had a fantastic shopping experience. They have an excellent collection of toy cars, Hot Wheels, RC vehicles, action figures, and gaming toys that both kids and collectors would absolutely love. The anime and trendy collectible section is also very unique and hard to find in regular gift shops.

Despite the crowd, the staff members were polite, cooperative, and helpful throughout the shopping experience. The store is well maintained, clean, and arranged in a way that makes browsing enjoyable and comfortable.

What really stood out to me was that the pricing is also very reasonable considering the quality, variety, and premium presentation of the products. You can easily find good gifting options across different budgets without feeling overpriced.

Overall, Happy Homes Mulund is a perfect destination for gifting, toy shopping, cute collectibles, and fun purchases for family and friends. Definitely one of the best and most unique gift shops in Mulund.

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: This morning we placed an order with Emotions The Florist for a flower bouquet to be delivered at my cousin's wedding venue [Raghavendra Mutt -Mulund West] at 10am. We had decided not to attend in view of the lockdown situation. However, we changed our mind and reached there. The florist had already delivered the bouquet which was placed on a table in the hall. On closer look, we were disappointed to see that the flowers were all yellow and had started wilting, leaves drooping and overall left us embarrassed to even gift it to the new couple. We immediately clicked a picture and updated the florist of the pathetic delivery. Not surprisingly, this fly-by-night shop has no respect for customers because he ignored our message and did not reply. Dear reader, please do not get duped by such however small or big the order may be. He ruined our beautiful morning with this dishonest service and thought of swindling us of our money.  Mr. Emotions The Florist, What an irony of a name! You clearly lack emotions...
